entries.1c02e4e0bbf44639: This is contract development of systems for financial institutions. It develops customer management system rebuilds and design-document and application-form creation systems for life insurance companies, an asset management platform for banks, and an IFA investment product order-support system for securities companies, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥9,121 million.
entries.a3fd9ed2a680d738: This business develops and provides systems for financial institutions such as life insurance companies, banks and securities companies, and the systems their customers use. Its main offering is front-end systems used directly by sales staff and customers, and it also handles conversion of back-office systems, such as life insurance contract management systems, to open languages and cloud migration, API provision of calculation logic for real estate valuation and inheritance tax, provision of an integrated asset management system, and family office services for wealthy individuals. The company's group operates a single segment for this business, conducting it through the group including three consolidated subsidiaries, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥9,689 million.
